description: Fail2ban Jail Config Audit — Audit a fail2ban jail.local / jail.d config, offline. text= is the INI file. Resolves effective values per jail (jail key, else [DEFAULT], else fail2ban defaults) and flags: no enabled jails, missing or disabled SSH jail, bantime 0 or under 10 minutes, permanent bans, maxretry too high or too low, findtime too short for slow brute force, ignoreip that whitelists everything or huge public ranges, hostnames in ignoreip, usedns = yes, dummy or hostsdeny actions, action_mwl log mailing, polling backend, SSH jail without backend = systemd on journald-only systems, no recidive jail or a weak one, bantime.increment off, duplicate sections and an edited jail.conf. Returns OK / REVIEW / WEAK, score, grade, a per-jail table (bantime, findtime, maxretry, port, backend, banaction) and findings with fixes. Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
